values.meaning: mana cost increase per stack of Living Artillery

mechanics.claim: The acid globule drops and deals damage 0.6 seconds after cast, not instantly.
mechanics.quote: spits a globule of acid into the air that drops to the target location after {{fd|0.6}} seconds

mechanics.claim: Damage scales up to a 50% bonus at 60% missing health, but is replaced entirely by a flat 100% (double) bonus if the target is below 40% maximum health, rather than the two bonuses stacking.
mechanics.quote: or instead by {{ccs|100%|magic}} if the target is below {{as|40% '''maximum''' health}}

mechanics.claim: Each cast refreshes the Living Artillery stack duration and adds a stack, up to 9, each stack permanently raising the ability's mana cost until it expires.
mechanics.quote: '''Kog'Maw''' then generates a {{tip|stack}} of ''Living Artillery'' for 8 seconds, refreshing on subsequent casts and stacking up to 9 times.

mechanics.claim: Living Artillery can be blocked by spell shields.
